maya: alert from sec-bot: partner S3 archive shows multiple base64 blobs matching Vault transit ciphertext pattern. rule=vault-wrap-detector-3. link: https://alerts.internal/ghi012
sec-bot: detection summary: matches=4, score=0.87, severity=high. recommended action: contain + forensic snapshot. :rotating_light:
raj: proposed immediate actions:
- freeze SA key creation (hold deploys)
- snapshot KMS key metadata + set up new key version for rewrap
- run canary `vault rewrap` on single object
- preserve audit logs to gs://forensic-archive/INC-2026-03122/
olivia: I'll run the canary script once raj confirms new key version. canary steps:
```
# disable offending key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=sa-ingest@redwood-ops.iam.gserviceaccount.com || true
# dry-run vault rewrap
curl -sS -X POST "https://vault.internal/v1/transit/rewrap/dry-run" -H "X-Vault-Token: $VAULT_TOKEN" -d '{"ciphertext":"OLD_CT"}'
```
raj: created new KMS version: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/tmp/cryptoKeys/partner-wrap/cryptoKeyVersions/7. do not flip Vault config until rewrap sweep completes.
oncall: acknowledged. pausing SA-key-creation deploys for 60m and starting access-log collection: `gsutil ls -L gs://partner-archive/2026-03-21/`
olivia: canary live rewrap done: 1/1 success. sample output: `[2026-03-21T23:55:02Z] rewrap ok: partner-archive/obj1 -> new_ct: cHJldmlvdXNf...`
maya: good. proceed with staged sweep at 100/min and tag all actions with incident id INC-2026-03122. tomas, will coordinate RBAC followups in a PR to block external SA key creation.
raj: sweep finished 4/4 rewrapped. uploaded logs to gs://forensic-archive/INC-2026-03122/rewrap.log. flipping Vault transit wrapping key in 5m after smoke tests.
sec-bot: audit reminder: export KMS/admin logs and Vault audit to forensic sink.
maya: drafting partner notification and incident ticket. owners: raj (KMS + rewrap), olivia (rewrap runbook + logs), tomas (RBAC policy PR), maya (partner comms). closing: will run post-incident audit and rotation checklist next 48h. :white_check_mark:
